title: Bible Story: Daniel in the den of lions
status: draft: written 19 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 2 Christian Religious Education; not yet checked by a CRE teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child retells Daniel in the lions' den (Daniel 6) and lists lessons: pray always, trust God, God protects, be faithful.

floor.prerequisite: Knows simple prayers at different times of day.
floor.question: When can we pray?
floor.answer: Morning, before meals, at night (any time)

contexts: being laughed at for doing right

board.do: Write: pray three times a day.
Wait for the child to say God.

misconceptions.ask: What did Daniel do after the new law?
How many times a day did Daniel pray?
misconceptions.repair: Count three prayer times: morning, midday, evening.

misconceptions.ask: Why did the lions not hurt Daniel?
How did King Darius feel when Daniel was thrown in?
misconceptions.repair: Read Daniel 6:14, 18. The officials tricked him.

checks.question: Why was Daniel thrown into the lions' den?
Name a lesson from the story.
